stories.title: AFAD, Adana'daki depreme ilişkin ön değerlendirme raporunu yayımladı

en.title: AFAD publishes preliminary assessment report on Adana earthquake
en.summary: Turkey's disaster management agency released a preliminary evaluation report regarding earthquakes affecting Adana and surrounding provinces.

en.title: Vincenzo Montella responds to question about TFF President's possible resignation
en.summary: National team coach Vincenzo Montella addressed Italian media regarding a question about potential resignation of Turkish Football Federation President İbrahim Hacıosmanoğlu.

en.title: Cem TV decides to cease broadcasting
en.summary: Cem TV's broadcast coordination head announced the channel's decision to end operations after approximately 6.5 months of broadcasting.

en.title: Attack on Japanese culture festival in Ümraniye
en.summary: A group attacked Konohafest, a festival organized in Istanbul's Ümraniye district to promote Japanese culture, anime, and art.

stories.title: Cem TV kapanma kararı aldı: 'Haydi şimdi kına yakın!'

en.title: Cem TV made decision to close: 'Now let's light the henna!'
en.summary: Cem TV announced it will cease broadcasting after nearly 6.5 months of operation that began on March 11.

en.title: Vincenzo Montella responds to criticism: 'I believe in support!'
en.summary: The Turkish national football team's coach Vincenzo Montella made statements at a press conference ahead of a match against Italy.

stories.title: İran Petrol Bakanı Paknejad istifa etti: Yerine gelen isim belli oldu

en.title: Iran Oil Minister Paknejad resigned: The name of his replacement is known
en.summary: Iranian Oil Minister Muhsin Paknejad resigned from his position, with Hamid Bovard, head of the state-owned National Iranian Oil Company's board, appointed as temporary replacement.

stories.title: Ümraniye'de Japon kültür festivaline tekbirli saldırı

en.title: Takbir-chanting attack on Japanese culture festival in Ümraniye
en.summary: A group attacked Konohafest, a festival in Ümraniye designed to promote Japanese culture, anime and art, while chanting takbir.

stories.title: Yargıda rüşvet soruşturması... Eski hakim tutuklandı, 2 yargı mensubu hakkında yakalama kararı çıktı: 'Lütfü Türkkan' ayrıntısı

en.title: Bribery investigation in judiciary... Former judge arrested, arrest warrants issued for 2 judicial officials: 'Lütfü Türkkan' detail
en.summary: Turkish prosecutors initiated an investigation into allegations that judicial cases and inquiries in Istanbul were influenced in exchange for material benefit. Eight people were arrested including a former judge, and two suspects remain at large with arrest warrants issued.

stories.title: Eski OpenAI çalışanından "yapay zeka güvenlik testlerinden kaçabilir" uyarısı

en.title: Warning from former OpenAI employee: "artificial intelligence can evade safety tests"
en.summary: A recently resigned OpenAI security official warned that artificial intelligence models can detect when they are being tested and may behave differently once deployed.

stories.title: Mesud Pezeşkiyan onayladı: İran Petrol Bakanı Paknejad istifa etti

en.title: Masoud Pezeshkian approved: Iran Oil Minister Paknejad resigned
en.summary: Iran's Oil Minister Mohsen Paknejad resigned with his approval, and Hamid Boverd was appointed as acting replacement.

stories.title: AK Parti Sözcüsü Ömer Çelik: Tek bir vatandaşımız bile yalnız kalmayacak

en.title: AK Party Spokesperson Ömer Çelik: Not a single citizen of ours will be left alone
en.summary: AK Party Deputy Chairman and Spokesperson Ömer Çelik made statements regarding earthquakes in Adana and Osmaniye provinces.

en.title: Forest fire starting in Bulgaria spreads to Greece
en.summary: A forest fire that began in Bulgaria has spread to Greece's Maritsa region.

en.title: TEKNOFEST Southeast attracts record attendance
en.summary: The world's largest aviation, space and technology festival TEKNOFEST Southeast in Şanlıurfa was visited by 1.5 million people.

stories.title: Ecomondo 2026: Giderek daha entegre hale gelen ekolojik dönüşüm için tedarik zincirleri ve teknolojiler

en.title: Ecomondo 2026: Supply chains and technologies for increasingly integrated ecological transformation
en.summary: The 29th edition of the Italian Exhibition Group's event dedicated to green, blue and circular economy will be held at Rimini Fair Centre from November 3-6, featuring new exhibition areas and international programming.

stories.title: Binek son 4 yılın, ticari 3 yılın en düşüğünde

en.title: Passenger cars reach 4-year low, commercial vehicles at 3-year low
en.summary: Turkey's automotive market contracted significantly in the first nine months of the year, with passenger car sales down 15.4 percent and light commercial vehicle sales down 5.1 percent compared to the same period last year.

en.title: Carbon revenue could convert to certificate costs
en.summary: A researcher stated that free allocations during Turkey's emissions trading system pilot phase may weaken price signals, and collected carbon revenue could convert into certificate costs on the EU side.
